meta.name: mem-search
meta.description: Search claude-mem's persistent cross-session memory database. Use when user asks "did we already solve this?", "how did we do X last time?", or needs work from previous sessions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把之前交流时确定的方案和说法直接找回来
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常和AI助手连续协作,却不时忘记上次聊过的结论
copy.tagline_en: Bring back the solution discussed in a previous session with one question
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often work with an AI assistant across sessions and forget past conclusions

howto.what: Claude 会去查你的历史会话记忆库:先用 search 拿到带 ID 的索引,再用 timeline 看前后上下文,只对筛出的条目用 get_observations 取详情;需要命令原始输出时才用 get_tool_uses。产出是跨会话的检索结果与摘要。
howto.when: 当你问起以往会话的事,比如“这个之前修过吗”“上次 X 是怎么做的”等,或需要复用之前会话的工作时触发。

say.text: 搜一下上个月关于登录改动记录
say.note: 先返回带 ID 的索引表

say.text: 上周那个迁移失败的命令,原始输出是什么
say.note: 先读摘要,不够再取原始 I/O

say.text: 把 #11131 前后各 3 条时间线列出来
say.note: 按时间顺序列出前后条目

howto.what_en: Claude searches your claude-mem cross-session memory database: first the search tool returns an index with IDs, then timeline shows surrounding context, and only filtered IDs are fetched via get_observations. Raw tool I/O via get_tool_uses is used only when summaries are not enough.
howto.when_en: Use when you ask about previous sessions—"did we already fix this?", "how did we solve X last time?"—or when work from earlier sessions is needed.

say_en.text: Search last month's records about the login change
say_en.note: Returns an index table with IDs first

say_en.text: What was the raw output of last week's failed migration?
say_en.note: Reads summary first, then raw I/O
